note: Descriptions match the labels on GitHub. Apply security-review to auth, secrets, CI, hooks, uploads, or data-access changes; needs-qa to any pull request that delivers acceptance criteria; needs-design to UI or packages/ui changes; needs-support-ops to emails, wording, or runbooks; human-step when a pull request waits on Brandon.

labels.name: full-ci
labels.description: Runs the full CI job (attachments, ClamAV, E2E, Electron, Docker, backups).

labels.name: security-review
labels.description: Touches auth, secrets, CI/workflows, hooks, uploads or data access; Architect review required.

labels.name: needs-qa
labels.description: Delivers acceptance criteria; QA review required.

labels.name: needs-design
labels.description: Changes UI or packages/ui; Designer review required.

labels.name: needs-support-ops
labels.description: Changes customer emails, wording or runbooks; Support Ops review required.

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Project Lead hold. A held pull request does not merge (plan 5.5).

labels.name: human-step
labels.description: Waiting on a step only Brandon can do (logged in HUMAN_STEPS_LOG).

labels.name: beta-bug
labels.description: Beta bug filed by the Project Lead from Brandon's report (T32).

labels.name: main-guard
labels.description: A push to main broke the provenance rules (ADR 0019).

labels.name: fix-main
labels.description: May merge during a main freeze. The pull request body must say Fixes #N.
